svg.font-family: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'SF Pro Text', 'Helvetica Neue', Arial, sans-serif
svg.title: Component · Tag field · empty · narrow
svg.desc: Mirrors the one tag editor shared by App/AI/AutoNameSheet.swift (its SUBJECT TAGS section), App/ProjectDetailView.swift (the managementCard Tags row and the sheet it raises) and App/GalleryPreviewPanel.swift (the TAGS block). The state that made this component necessary: a project the analysis returned NO subject tags for, or one that has never been analysed. The field is still drawn — only the "+ Add tag" chip is left — so tagging by hand is reachable without an AI run at all. Width is the macOS Gallery preview panel's 272pt content column, where the block runs full width under its own TAGS header rather than inside a 72pt-label metaRow.
